systemSummary.name: Windmill Developer Workflow & Script Platform
systemSummary.description: High-performance workflow engine executing OpenFlow DAGs and multi-language scripts backed by PostgreSQL transactional queues and advisory locking.

executionEngine.description: Flow evaluation engine orchestrating step DAGs, loops, branches, and approvals.

queueLayer.description: PostgreSQL SKIP LOCKED queue poller with workspace fairness weighting.

workerLayer.description: Multi-language worker processes executing Deno, Python, Go, and Bash scripts.

storageLayer.description: Relational PostgreSQL storage for job records, execution payloads, and state.

durableExecutionModel.openFlowDAGs: Workflows are structured as declarative OpenFlow DAGs. Flow state is persisted in PostgreSQL after each step completes.
durableExecutionModel.databaseQueuePolling: Workers poll jobs from PostgreSQL tables using SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, guaranteeing exactly-once lease assignment.
durableExecutionModel.resumableSuspension: Flows suspend on approvals or external webhooks, persisting execution state in PostgreSQL without holding worker processes.
durableExecutionModel.tokenConfinement: Ephemeral job tokens minted for script runs are strictly confined to workspace API scopes.
durableExecutionModel.fairnessScheduling: Queue scheduler applies Deficit Round Robin (DRR) weights across workspaces to prevent noisy neighbors.
